cases.purpose: Exercise init and reset on a reserved kernel text console mapped to a connected, enabled Intel display.
cases.oracle: Debian ncurses tput, the VT termios state, /dev/vcsa screen cells and cursor, and a no-op control against explicitly seeded states.
cases.comparison: Compare status, complete termios, screen contents and cursor for the packaged linux entry and a separately compiled entry with identifiable init/reset effects.
